sheet.title: HEADWORKS FACILITY P&ID
sheet.issue_status: DESIGN/BUILD DOCUMENTS - prepared for submission to EPA in July 2021 to provide a general understanding of the project concept; not intended to reflect design requirements
legend_notes: Sheet 9 of 25. Revision table is blank.

Horizontal dash-dot lines labelled SCADA and MCP divide the sheet into bands: trapezoid symbols above the SCADA line are SCADA points; circle-in-square bubbles between the SCADA and MCP lines are MCP functions; items below the MCP line are field.
Arrowheads into SCADA/MCP symbols are drawn either open or filled (apparently discrete vs analog); no legend on this sheet.

Equipment label blocks along the bottom (SCREENING SLIDE GATE x2, SCREENING WASHER SPRAY WATER VALVES, FINE SCREEN, BAR RACK SLIDE GATE x2, MANUAL BAR RACK) each show only '100' and an empty 'SPEC:'; tag numbers are incomplete.
Dash-dot outline labelled VENDOR PACKAGE encloses the fine screen, its level instruments and the three spray water solenoid valves.
No line numbers or pipe sizes are printed on this sheet; service codes RS and 3W appear on the inlet flags only.
